description: This file defines an abstract base class 'VisitorBase' for implementing the Visitor pattern in the MigraDoc document processing library. It contains methods for traversing and transforming various document elements such as paragraphs, tables, charts, headers, and page setup configurations, applying flattening and inheritance logic to style and formatting properties.

classes.name: VisitorBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for visiting and processing document objects in the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Overrides for visiting various document elements such as Chart, Document, Paragraph, Section, Table, etc., implementing the traversal and flattening logic.

methods.name: FlattenParagraphFormat
methods.description: Recursively flattens a ParagraphFormat by inheriting properties from a reference format where not explicitly set.

methods.name: FlattenFont
methods.description: Copies font properties from a reference font to a target font where properties are not set.

methods.name: FlattenShading
methods.description: Copies shading properties if missing in the target shading.

methods.name: FlattenBorders
methods.description: Fills in missing border properties from a reference borders collection.

methods.name: FlattenBorder
methods.description: Fills in missing border properties from a reference border.

methods.name: FlattenTabStops
methods.description: Merges tab stops from a reference set into a current TabStops collection.

methods.name: FlattenPageSetup
methods.description: Merges and potentially swaps page setup properties, taking into account orientation, page size, and margins.

methods.name: RealizeOrientation
methods.description: Adjusts PageWidth and PageHeight to match the specified orientation.

methods.name: UpdateOrientation
methods.description: Sets page orientation based on the current PageWidth and PageHeight.

methods.name: ParagraphFormatFromStyle
methods.description: Creates a ParagraphFormat based on a style, combining style parameters with defaults.

methods.name: GetDocumentElementHolder
methods.description: Finds the parent document object that holds a given DocumentObject, such as a section or header/footer.
